Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.197/2021 PS Special Cell under sections 419/420 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes in terms of settlement agreement dated 1 st February, 2022, which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner nos. 1 and 2 and respondent no.2-complainant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by the IO and the counsel.
3. As per the settlement, a balance amount of Rs.1,25,000/- is to be paid to the respondent no.2.
It is informed that Rs.25,000/- has already been paid to the respondent no.2 which fact is verified by the respondent no.2.

Balance amount of Rs.1,00,000/- has been handed over to respondent no.2 in the Court today who has duly accepted the same and submits that in view of the settlement, he has no objection to quashing of the FIR.

4. Additionally, the petitioners have undertaken to provide social services for 2 hours a day, every Friday, for the next two months at Madina Masjid, Mathura, U.P.
5.

Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.197/2021 PS Special Cell under sections 419/420 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom
are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as Mohd Shaad & Anr vs State & Anr on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38460537/
1 infructuous.
8.
